p3.geometry: official polygon or multipolygon only from a complete permitted source artifact

p7.geometry: point when explicitly supplied; not polygon or building footprint

postal_system.normalization_rule: Retain literal P and all digits, including leading zeroes. Never pad a P3 area to P7, strip a P7 suffix to imply point containment, or accept placeholder XXXX as an assignment.
postal_system.assignment_rule: One P3 code can relate to multiple localities. Preserve row-level source identity and ambiguity; names are not stable unique keys.
postal_system.geometry_rule: The MTDE catalog lists official P3 boundaries. No complete polygon artifact was retrieved in this review; missing geometry remains none. Never generate an official area from town labels, P7 points, Voronoi, administrative overlap or AGID cells.
postal_system.address_rule: P7 final-point suffix is not a street number. Display a house number or building only from separate rights-cleared civic-address/building records with an explicit source identifier relation.
postal_system.licence_rule: Publisher cc-by metadata links a generic licence index with multiple versions. Do not silently assign CC-BY-4.0; confirm exact applicable version, attribution, artifact scope and derivative rights.
postal_system.crs_rule: Catalog says longitude/latitude order but does not establish a CRS/datum/accuracy statement. Do not assume EPSG:4326. Require reviewed CRS and topology before geometry output.
postal_system.freshness_rule: 2021 resource and catalog timestamps are not current assignment validity. Keep retrieval time, source edition, valid-time and known-time separate.
postal_system.territory_rule: Keep repository PS / Palestine / فلسطين identity and exact source-stated coverage. Postal coverage and missing regions are not sovereignty or boundary determinations.
postal_system.privacy_rule: No recipients, customers, owners, residents, contacts, units, tracking or land-rights records in public artifacts.

stages.definition: Reviewed source, rights and authority-separation contract with AGID address-format integration and reproducible aggregate checks.

A current, complete, rights-cleared PS P3 postal-area release links the official code/locality assignment list to actual official polygon or multipolygon records by explicit source identifiers. Pin publisher, coverage, edition and validity, retrieval time, SHA-256, exact licence version and attribution, CRS/datum/axis order, reproducible transformation, geometry/topology and code-join validation, and exception handling. Publish approved immutable digest-pinned artifacts and verify the real PS AGID loader/API. P7 delivery-point codes and coordinates stay a separate authority layer; a P3 polygon, P7 suffix, locality name, administrative overlap or nearest feature cannot supply a house number or building without a separately permitted explicit address/building relation. Preserve PS identity and source-stated territorial coverage. A sample, catalog entry, partial download, historical list, reference document or synthetic test alone cannot achieve M2.
Separately rights-cleared current P7 delivery-point records with validated explicit P3 relations and permitted coordinates; no building or house-number inference.
Rights-cleared civic address and building geometry linked by explicit stable source relations, with ambiguity, privacy and temporal validation.

agid_integration.current_scope: PS address form accepts canonical P3 and P7 syntax and explains their different authority. Source catalog is metadata only. No production PS Postal Context descriptor is enabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: Complete permitted immutable P3 artifact, a PS runtime descriptor and actual loader/API tests are required; metadata tests do not satisfy this.
agid_integration.geometry_output: none until verified; official / derived / virtual remain distinct
agid_integration.building_output_gate: explicit independently permitted address/building relation required
